# Warlock AI Xai

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-xai`

> xAI Grok adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [ai-xai](@warlock.js/ai-xai/skills/SKILL.md): xAI Grok adapter for Warlock AI: `XaiSDK`, `XAI_CHAT_MODELS`, `inferVisionCapability`, `inferReasoningCapability` and `XaiModelConfig`. Use for "connect Grok", streaming, tools, vision, reasoning, model capabilities or pricing overrides through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents, tools and workflows; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
